Applicability: All
Indicator: Number of complaints submitted to the internal-complaints mechanism
Contextual Information:
The total number of EU player appeals submitted for any of the following reasons:
1. Discuss Game Bans
2. Discuss Chat Restriction
3. Discuss Queue Timer Restriction
4. Discuss a Chargeback Ban
5. Discuss a Forced Name Change

An important distinction between the total appeals here and the total penalties within '6_own_initiative_TC' is that the latter only includes penalties that resulted in temporary or permanent suspension. For appeals, all tickets submitted - regardless of penalty or restriction type - are included in this total.
